findings.title: Israeli attacks on Gaza kill senior education official, seven other people
findings.affected_population_system: Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital medics identified the previously reported couple as Gaza education undersecretary Khaled Abu Nada and his wife and reported six other people injured, several critically. Israeli leaders confirmed Abu Nada's killing and described him as a Hamas figure with economy and education responsibilities. No independent verification of the latter characterization or individual civilian status. No additional deaths claimed for this incident.
